answer: Identity in this economy is earned like crossing a canyon on a narrow ridge: each agent must complete a unique sequential computation — a crystal-clear proof of work that cannot be parallelized or shared between identities — before it can transact. The proof takes hours, costs real compute per identity, and requires a bond locked until it finishes. A sybil attacker must repeat that whole slow climb for every fake identity, so faking a thousand agents costs a thousand times the compute and locked capital, while honest agents pay it once.
